SignalDeck is a free and open-source project (GPL-3.0): free to use, free to study and free to improve, and it stays that way. If you like it, there are three ways to help it grow.

Everything is in one zip (%1$s kB). Tap Send to share it by e-mail, a messenger or a cloud drive, or open a GitHub issue and drag the zip in.\n\nThe folder is also on the phone: Download/DMR/DeviceReport/%2$s (with a computer: adb pull /sdcard/Download/DMR/DeviceReport).

The report holds phone model and build facts, serial-port and radio-module node names, the walkie-talkie app\'s package details, library and framework file names, running radio processes, and (with root) SELinux labels and short radio-related log excerpts with message text removed and long numbers masked. After Run all checks it also holds SignalDeck\'s own log (packet, position, message and caller lines removed; callsigns and IDs masked), the bytes the stock app exchanged with the radio module while it started (stock_serial.txt: commands, channel frequencies and the module\'s answers; radio IDs blanked) and, after the trial, a 5-second raw copy of what the radio received (rx_audio_raw.bin: whatever the channel carried). No accounts, contacts, messages, location or identifiers such as IMEI.\n\nThe copied stock walkie-talkie APK is the manufacturer\'s software: include it if you are comfortable posting it, or share without it (we can ask for it privately).
